test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 27 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Choose the correctly spelt word:
solution:
The correct answer is **option 1 i.e. Accommodate.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Accommodate** is the correct spelling of the word, which means "to provide lodging or sufficient space for someone or something" or "to adapt to a new situation or environment."
 
• It is one of the frequently misspelled words in English due to the double 'c' and double 'm'.</li
